title: Certify every IFX detector family and confinement boundary on one final 1.1.3 candidate
goal: Complete C6c with an independent dual-platform clean, rule-violation, missing-input and zero-match matrix plus lock, capability, root-confinement and Database-hermeticity controls on one fresh source-bound bundle.
acceptanceCriteria: One committed runner implementation freezes a machine-readable matrix for all 37 modules and 80 blocking rules; both platforms return at least 191 core case results from identical fixture bytes with exact expected identities and categories.

A clean native Windows checkout and clean native Linux checkout independently reproduce the Database producer's complete selected path/hash inventory from committed inputs and pinned offline dependencies without transporting node_modules or other working-tree bytes.

All seven lock families reject missing, altered, stale or expired, wrong-commit and post-production-change controls; capability broadening, root overlap, path escape and attempted PackageRoot/TargetRoot writes fail closed while immutable-root hashes remain equal.

On one final implementation commit, Windows-full, offline Linux-complete, direct Pre 10/22, direct Post 27/57 and dependency Post 37/79 pass against the same fresh 0.3.0 bundle and published 1.1.3 archive with matching semantic projections and exact receipts.

Formal Pre, isolated IFX Package regression and exact committed Formal Diff pass; the decision does not claim Xiaolong Feng acceptance, C6e installed composition, P10.2 parity, P10.3 activation or V3 retirement.
